items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: No, but they had that Beneke Tex Beneke. Oh yeah, and they could do it.

ctx.x: But they didn't have anybody singing like Nat, did they?

No, but they had that Beneke Tex Beneke. Oh yeah, and they could do it. You know, they don't invent too much, but I mean, they can copy. They are the best copyers in the world; anything you can think of, the things you by -- and they'll improve on anything someone else invents. So they
take it right through. Through everything.
